rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you for reaching out - I really appreciate it. I'm still figuring out exactly what Halcyon Threshold will focus on, and having someone with data analysis skills involved early is valuable for shaping that direction. A few areas I'm considering where your skills could make a real difference: - Identifying gaps in public AI safety/alignment research (what's studied vs. what's neglected) - Evaluating small organizations in this space to help with potential micro-grants - Building datasets or analysis around AI development trends Would any of these interest you? Or is there something you've seen in this space that you think is underserved and that you'd want to work on? Happy to jump on a call this week if that's easier than email. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Priya Raman — Accepted her volunteer offer, asked about her interests (gap analysis, evaluation support, or data work). Awaiting reply.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Idris Bellamy <grants@emberfallfund.org> with subject "Re: Rapid grants — yes, you can still apply". It read: "Hi Idris, Thanks for the details on the rapid grants process - this is very helpful. I'm working on a proposal and have a few questions that would help me scope it appropriately: 1. For someone new to the field without a research track record, are there project types you've found work better for first-time grantees? (e.g., synthesis/survey work vs. original research) 2. Would a project involving a small team (one primary applicant with a volunteer contributor) fit your model, or do you prefer solo applicants? 3. Are there specific neglected areas Emberfall is hoping to see more proposals address? I want to make sure I'm proposing something useful rather than duplicating existing work. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Idris Bellamy (Emberfall) — Asked clarifying questions about grant preferences for newcomers, team structure, and neglected areas.

rows.quote: Website published — https://halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app is live with mission statement and contact info.
